adminChooseAll: Choose every suggested proposal on this page
adminApproveRestOne: Reject the one left out, approve the rest
adminApproveRestOther: Reject the {count} left out, approve the rest
adminNeedReasonSource: Give a reason, and cite a source where the form asks for one.
adminNoChange: No change yet: a report waits for a change, edited in below.
adminChangesetHint: Edit it, then save with a note: it is validated again.
adminDeleteHint: Deleting withdraws the record from the catalog, with the records that need it, and cuts its links from the others. Its history keeps every version.
adminJsonHint: JSON: the validator checks its shape.
adminManyHint: Hold Ctrl or ⌘ to choose several.
adminSearchRunning: Running… the current index serves until it ends.
adminSettingsIntro: Every setting the AI uses and search run with now. Each says how it changes: here, through the review queue, on the next call; or by a registry change and a deploy.
adminSettingsModelWhat: Model: the language model the use runs. Changed here; the next call runs on it.
adminSettingsPromptWhat: Prompt: the instructions the model follows, and their version, in data/prompts/. Changed by a new version and a deploy.
adminSettingsCapsWhat: Caps: the most a use may spend in a month and call in a day, and for Ask, one visitor's calls a day. A call past one is refused before the model is asked. Changed here; the next call reads them.
adminSettingsModels: The models a use may run
adminSettingsModelsWhat: Each price is the provider's, as read on the day shown. Costs count in CAD at {rate} to the US dollar, above the year's rate, so a cap errs low. The models, their prices and the rate change by a registry change (data/registry/ai.json) and a deploy.
adminSettingsChangeWhat: Approved at once through the review queue and applied on the next call. A value left empty keeps the use's.
adminSettingsNever: The registry's model and caps: never changed.
adminSettingsEmbedder: The live index is built with {model}, {dimension} dimensions.
adminSettingsEmbedderWhat: The embedding model turns products and queries into vectors, for semantic search and for Ask when no word of a question matches. It is search.json's model: a change there takes a rebuild of the index:
adminSettingsKnobsWhat: These change by a registry change (data/registry/search.json) and a deploy: the site and the server read the same file.
adminKnobFieldsWhat: How much a query word found in each field counts.
adminKnobWholeWordWhat: A word matched whole counts this many times a word matched by its start.
adminKnobPairBoostWhat: Two query words found near each other add the field's weight times this.
adminKnobPairWindowWhat: How many words apart two query words may be and still count as neighbours.
adminKnobExactBoostWhat: Added when the query is a product's name, slug or id.
adminKnobRelativeCutWhat: Products scoring under this share of the best result are dropped.
adminKnobSemanticThresholdWhat: A vector match less similar than this is left out.
adminKnobRrfKWhat: Blends the keyword and vector lists: a product at rank r in a list adds 1/(k + r), so a higher k evens out the top ranks.
adminKnobEvidenceWhat: The most products an answer rests on: the best by keyword, else by vector.
adminKnobStopwordsWhat: How many words a query drops, in the site's languages.
adminRefusedOffTopic: Refused: nothing in the catalog matches the question.
adminRefusedEvidence: Refused: the evidence does not answer it.
adminNewsCitesField: Sentence {n} rests on (ids of products, organizations or sources, comma-separated)
adminNewsEventSource: The source of that date (a source id a sentence cites)
